messages:
Alex: Heads-up — I'm handing off tonight's oncall at 20:00 UTC. Doing a quick preflight. Can everyone confirm the following before 19:45?
- VPN / Okta SSO
- PagerDuty escalations
- Runbook access + latest runbook link
- SSH / KMS creds for emergency nodes
- Observability alerts test

Priya: I'm on VPN and can access runbooks. link: https://redwood.runbooks.company/oncall/main-runbook (read-only for now)
Sam: PagerDuty access OK, added myself to the rotation. Tested notifications earlier.
Alex: Sam can you verify the test alert triggers pager? If not, file a quick follow-up.
Sam: Ran a test: `redwoodctl alert test --service inference-api` -> Pager pinged me :white_check_mark: 
Priya: Okta reported MFA prompt earlier; if anyone gets MFA failures, try this: `okta verify push` or re-enroll.
Alex: infra-bot, can you run the preflight scripts and paste results?
infra-bot: Preflight run started at 1793456795
infra-bot: VPN: ok
infra-bot: Okta SSO: ok
infra-bot: PagerDuty: service inference-api -> healthy
infra-bot: KMS access test: FAILED -> IAM role redwood/oncall-read needs kms:Decrypt
infra-bot: Observability hooks: sampling OK
Alex: Noted KMS failure. @Priya can you escalate to infra-iam? Put the short fix in the runbook if they apply.
Priya: Escalating now. Quick mitigation: use ephemeral keys via `redwoodctl token issue --scope oncall --ttl 1h` until IAM fix.
Sam: Used `redwoodctl token issue` and can access the node. :thumbsup: 
Alex: Also updating runbook to include the ephemeral token command and the new Okta step.
Alex: Final quick checklist for the oncall swap:
• Confirmed VPN: yes
• Runbook link accessible: yes
• Pager tested: yes
• KMS workaround in place: yes (ephemeral token)
• Observability tests: pass

Alex: If anyone else hits anything weird before 20:00 UTC ping here. Passing handoff to Sam at 20:00.
oncall-scheduler: Reminder: Sam is primary 20:00-08:00 UTC. Priya backup. :bell: 
Priya: ack
Sam: ack, taking it. I'll do a short smoke at start of shift.
Alex: thanks all, dropping off.
